properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: An agricultural yard at a farmstead towards the edge of the settlement. Now effectively redundant as farming activity on the steading site has gradually reduced over the years. The sites was previously occupied by three large modern farm buildings but these have already been cleared. A lower yield is fitting for rural location. A scheme has been granted permission to provide 6 dwellings (16/04562/FUL). Development underway and forecast for completion within the next 5 years.
